title: Observability weekly - 2026-08-31
content:
Weekly notes: Observability team standup + sync (Mon 2026-08-31)

Attendees: Claire Nguyen (owner), Ravi Menon, Lena Park, Diego Alvarez, Mei Zhou (guest - infra)

1) Highlights
- Tracing: Rolled out sampling rule change for low-traffic tenants (reduces stored spans by ~22%); initial smoke tests show no loss in error-context traces.
- Dashboards: New API tail-latency dashboard (P50/P95/P99) deployed to Console; added anomaly overlays for incidents in July.
- Cost telemetry: Prototype "per-model token cost" dashboard is live internally; basic attribution pipeline is running and matches billing within 3% on daily rollups.
- Alerts: Updated alert thresholds for gpu-inference-latency alert to account for Canary routing; alert noise down ~15%.

2) Metrics snapshot (daily rollup 2026-08-30)
- Ingested spans/day: 8.1M (post-sampling)
- Traces retained (7d): 2.9M
- API P95 (global hosted API): 410ms
- Token processing cost (hosted pool): $0.011/token-equivalent (approx)
- Dashboard queries per minute: 1.2k

3) Tracing workstream updates
- Sampling & retention (Ravi): Sampling rule rollout is at 60% of tenants. Next: add tenant-level override UI in Console (blocked on console DP work).
- Span tagging (Lena): Standardized span tags for model_id and deployment_variant merged (PR #87). Will backfill legacy pipelines with a mapping table.
- Distributed context (Diego): Fixed header propagation bug for some internal SDK clients — patch deployed in staging, schedule prod deploy Thu 2026-09-03.

Risks/Notes: need to monitor trace-based SLO dashboards for surfaced gaps due to sampling; create synthetic flows to validate end-to-end across tenant types.

4) Dashboards & visualization
- New dashboards shipped: API tail-latency, Model-cost-by-route, KV-cache-hit-rate.
- UX feedback: product team wants a lightweight view for PMs that hides sampling-level artifacts — design ticket created (CON-980).
- Perf: Some dashboard queries against long-term storage are slow; plan: pre-compute hourly rollups for the 30-day view (proposal by Mei).

5) Cost telemetry (priority for Q3)
- Pipeline: ingestion -> per-request attribution (model_id, route, tenant) -> daily rollups -> Console dashboard.
- Current accuracy: ~97% per-day when compared to billing exports for top 10 tenants.
- Next: augment attribution to include batching overhead and caching savings (action item: Ravi to propose schema by Fri 2026-09-04).

6) Incident notes (last 7 days)
- Aug 28: spike in API tail latency tied to a misrouted canary traffic. Mitigation: routed traffic to fallback model variant and widened autoscaler margin. Postmortem draft linked.
- Action: improve canary route weight decay algorithm and add alert to auto-fallback after 3 consecutive high-P99 windows.

7) Action items & owners
- Claire: Draft tenant-level sampling UI spec and sync with Console PM (due 2026-09-07).
- Ravi: Sampling schema doc and runbook entry for rollback (due 2026-09-04).
- Lena: Backfill mapping for legacy span tags and run data validation (due 2026-09-10).
- Diego: Prod deploy for context propagation fix and follow-up smoke tests (deploy 2026-09-03).
- Mei (infra): Proposal for hourly rollups for dashboard speed (due 2026-09-06).

8) Blockers
- Console DP team has bandwidth constraints; blocking tenant override UI. (owner: Claire to escalate).
- Long-term storage query performance needs infra coordination (owner: Mei).

9) Standup snippets (daily log highlights)
- 2026-08-31: Ravi - "sampling rollout continues, observed CPU reduction on span-processor by 12%"
- 2026-08-31: Lena - "merged standardized tags, waiting on backfill window"
- 2026-08-31: Diego - "context header fix in staging; adding integration tests"

10) Notes / Open questions
- How to present cost savings from prefix/KV cache in tenant billing UI? Proposal: two-line item (cache-savings, batching-savings) with toggle to view adjusted cost.
- Should we expose sampling rates to customers? Risks: support load + confusion. Recommend a Console opt-in for advanced tenants.

11) Meeting cadence & next sync
- Weekly Observability sync: Mondays 10:00am PT. Next deep-dive on cost telemetry Wed 2026-09-02 2:00pm PT.

Appendices / links:
- Trace runbook: confluence:OBS-Runbook-2026
- Sampling rollout doc: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/roadmap/sampling.md
- Postmortem (Aug 28): confluence:INC-2026-08-28-canary-latency

Summary: Solid progress on sampling and cost telemetry prototype; main focus next week is Console work for tenant controls, backfill for standardized span tags, and improving dashboard query performance.
